title: The Hollow Depths
subtitle: A dungeon that is different every time
description: Dungeon crawler. Three generated floors, tactical fights, one crown.
author: Daniel Sandner
default_hint: Read the enemy's tell: guard when a heavy blow is coming, strike while it winds up. 'map' shows the floor; shrines (+) heal.
help: Goal: descend three floors and take the Ember Crown. 'map' is your friend. 'pray' at a shrine, 'trade' with the peddler.
about: A demo dungeon crawler for the CLIo engine: procedural mazes, generated sprites and music, tactical combat.

character_creation.intro: Emberfall has been cold since the Hollow King carried its crown into the catacombs. Tonight somebody is going down after it.

warrior.name: Warrior
warrior.description: Tough and steady. Shield Bash stuns; learns Cleave.
warrior.text: You heft your sword and shield. They have seen worse than this. Probably.

rogue.name: Rogue
rogue.description: Quick and sharp. Critical hits, dodges, spots traps, picks locks.
rogue.text: You check your daggers, your tools and your exits, in that order.

mystic.name: Mystic
mystic.description: Fragile but dangerous. Firebolt ignores armour; Mend heals. Starts each fight with extra focus.
mystic.text: You warm your hands on nothing at all. It will do.
